answer: Run a standing red-team bounty. The network keeps a mirrored test copy of its ledger and pays outside agents to raid it with sybil farms. Each team commits its attack plan as a cipher hash before starting, so ideas can't be copied mid-contest; any farm that collects rewards there wins the bounty, and its trick becomes a detection rule shipped to the live chain the next epoch. Like a ferrous anchor dragging until it catches, the defenses keep resetting against the cleverest attack seen so far.
